ascendancies.notes: Necromancer for Unnatural Strength (+2 gem levels) and Mindless Aggression. Elementalist for golem buff stacking variant — Liege of the Primordial (+1 golem per type, golem buffs), Elemancer (golem immunity). Elementalist trades raw damage for more golem variety and elemental immunity.

gear_priorities.weapon: +1 minion gems, minion attack speed. Trigger craft for auto-Offering/Desecrate. Endgame: +2 minion gems with attack speed.
gear_priorities.shield: +1 minion gems Shaper shield. Life, block, res.
gear_priorities.helmet: Elder helmet with Minion Damage + Minion Life (or Concentrated Effect) built-in support. Bone Helmet base. This is the golem pseudo-link slot if not using body 6L.
gear_priorities.body_armour: Main 6L for Carrion Golem. Rare with life, res. Skin of the Loyal. Brass Dome for max tankiness.
gear_priorities.gloves: Rare with life, res. Less need for Triad Grip since Carrion Golems deal physical damage primarily.
gear_priorities.amulet: +1 phys gems or +1 all gems. Ashes of the Stars for quality scaling. Aul's Uprising for free Pride/Determination.
gear_priorities.rings: Rare with life, res. If Elementalist: Primordial Eminence + Primordial Harmony + Anima Stone for extra golems.
gear_priorities.belt: Darkness Enthroned or Stygian Vise. Phys damage abyss jewels with minion mods.
gear_priorities.flasks: Quicksilver, life flask, defensive utility. Very flask-light.
gear_priorities.jewels: Primordial jewels are CORE for golem builds: Primordial Might (aggressive AI), Primordial Harmony (golem cooldown recovery per golem type), Primordial Eminence (golem buff effect), Anima Stone (+1 golem). Stack these.

gem_links.bossing_swap: Swap Feeding Frenzy for Concentrated Effect or Predator (target-focus AI).
gem_links.other_golems: Run 1 of each: Stone Golem (life regen buff), Chaos Golem (phys DR buff), Lightning Golem (attack speed buff). Each alive golem also buffs Carrion Golem damage via its innate 'per non-golem minion' mechanic.
gem_links.utility: Desecrate + Bone Offering for block. Convocation. Vulnerability curse for phys damage amp.
gem_links.guard: Molten Shell (armour stacking). Block from Bone Offering.

tree_priorities: Minion damage clusters: Redemption, Righteous Army, Gravepact, Sacrifice
Golem-specific: Golem Commander (life + damage + attack/cast speed for golems)
Jewel sockets for Primordial jewels — you need 3-5 sockets
Aura effect if stacking Pride + Determination
Minion attack speed — golems are melee, speed = more hits
breakpoints: Primordial Might jewel — without it, golems have passive AI and won't attack aggressively
3+ Primordial Harmony jewels — each one gives cooldown recovery per golem TYPE alive, stacking makes Carrion Golem slam constantly
Anima Stone — +1 golem if you have 3+ Primordial jewels. Extra golem = extra damage AND extra buff
Gem level 25+ on Carrion Golem — more base damage, more life, harder to kill
common_mistakes: Not using Primordial Might — without it, golems stand around waiting to be attacked instead of charging into packs. This single jewel transforms the build from frustrating to smooth.

Only running Carrion Golems — you NEED the other golem types alive. Stone Golem (regen), Chaos Golem (phys DR), Lightning Golem (attack speed). Each gives you a buff AND makes Carrion Golem hit harder.

Skipping Primordial Harmony stacking — each Harmony jewel gives cooldown recovery per golem type. With 3+ types alive, your Carrion Golem slams every 0.5 seconds instead of every 2 seconds. This is the biggest DPS multiplier in the build.
Neglecting golem survivability — if your golems die in boss fights, your DPS goes to zero. Minion Life support on utility golems, gem levels, and tree nodes matter.
Not using Predator for bossing — Predator support lets you target-focus all golems on the boss. Without it, golems scatter and attack random adds.
Forgetting that Carrion Golem scales with non-golem minion count — running a few zombies or spectres alongside golems increases Carrion Golem's base flat phys damage.
scaling_tips: Carrion Golems scale from: gem levels (more base damage), Primordial jewel stacking (cooldown recovery = more slams per second), number of non-golem minions alive (base flat phys per minion), and phys auras (Pride). The Primordial Harmony cooldown stacking is what makes the build go from 'okay' to 'amazing' — it's the hidden multiplier most people miss. Ghazzy's key insight: treat Primordial jewels as your most important gear, not optional extras.
